basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco living in this beautifully renovated, two-level 4BD/3BA home, part of an exclusive two-unit condominium building. Flooded with natural light and offering the feel of a single-family home, this residence features exclusive use of a landscaped private yarda true urban oasis. The main level offers a spacious layout with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a sun-drenched sunroom/home office. The lower level, with its separate entrance, adds incredible flexibility with a fourth bedroom, a full bath, and two expansive rooms that open directly to the serene yard,perfect for multi-generational living, a guest suite, or a creative workspace. Completely renovated with high-end finishes and thoughtful upgrades throughout, no detail has been overlooked. Located just three blocks from Golden Gate Park, near top-rated schools, and moments from the Richmond's best restaurants, cafes, and shops.
